newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy coy on second half outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy coy on second half outlook.

text.p: Gold miner Normandy Mining Ltd said on Tuesday it expected improvements from the Mount Leyshon gold mine in the second half of 1996/97 and would start full contributions from Goldfields Power in Western Australia.

"Other factors influencing the second half will be a full six month contribution from Goldfields Power, anticipated improvements at Mt Leyshon, and an initial contribution from the new Vera-Nancy gold mine (in Queensland)," Normandy said
Normandy earlier reported a net profit of A$51.6 million in the six months ended December 31, 1996, compared with A$20.2 million a year earlier.
